# Text cleaner

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/text-cleaner/

Clean pasted text by trimming lines, collapsing repeated spaces, removing duplicate lines or joining the content into one line.

## How to use it

1. Type or paste the text you want to work with.
2. Choose a conversion, clean-up or output option.
3. Copy the result or download it when an export is available.

## Example

Remove duplicated entries from a short list before choosing a name at random.

## Limits and checks

Each clean-up mode performs one operation. Duplicate-line removal compares complete lines, including their original case.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
